name: Smart Farm Plot Floating Island
limitation: No EcoSolutions reference image was available. Visible and hidden geometry is a stylized interpretation of the written brief, not an image-matched reconstruction.

objectClass.structureKind: layered assembly with repeated crop modules
objectClass.motionPotential: whole-object transform with reversible component actions

coordinateSystem.polygonInput: GeoJSON longitude/latitude converted around the polygon centroid

deterministicSeedRule.algorithm: 32-bit FNV-1a string hash followed by Mulberry32
deterministicSeedRule.invariant: The same plot id and plant count produce the same crop layout in desktop and lite modes; lite mode uses the deterministic prefix of the desktop layout.

qualityContract.definitionOfDone: A readable floating plot island with a GeoJSON-derived top silhouette, three separable soil bands, a faceted moisture-tinted underside, crop-specific procedural repetition, clickable data hotspots, keyboard and pointer control, and a complete static fallback.

silhouette.target: The top-down outline preserves the source plot polygon while the side view reads as a compact floating island with a distinct faceted point.
blockingFailures: generic circular or rectangular top footprint
underside detached from the soil body
crop canopy obscures the complete plot outline

soilStrataReadability.target: Three adjacent soil bands remain distinguishable by value and hue at the default camera and become more legible when Soil Metrics is active.
blockingFailures: explode action that cannot return to the resting state

cropRecognizability.target: Rice and jute read as slender upright tufts; tomato, brinjal, and chili read as stem, foliage, and fruit impressions; potato reads as low clustered foliage.
blockingFailures: all crop models share one silhouette
instances extend outside the polygon footprint
random placement changes between openings of the same plot

interaction.target: Hover tilt, orbit drag, touch rotation and zoom, keyboard controls, idle rotation, hotspot tab activation, reduced motion, focus return, and reversible metric actions all work without competing transforms.
blockingFailures: hover tilt continues during OrbitControls drag
closing leaves animation or listeners running
a data label intercepts pointer input
the dialog has no always-visible close control

performance.target: Stay within the declared geometry, instance, and DPR budgets; use instancing for crop repetition; render only while the dialog is open and visible.
blockingFailures: crop plant count exceeds the active mode cap

componentHierarchy.role: whole-object pivot and runtime metadata owner
componentHierarchy.geometryStrategy: No geometry; owns hover, idle, and bob transforms.
componentHierarchy.pivot: centroid at the vertical middle of the island

children.geometryStrategy: Container for independently addressable macro components.
THREE.Shape from the normalized GeoJSON outer ring, then shallow THREE.ExtrudeGeometry rotated onto XZ.

children.topology: three separate closed shape extrusions under stable Group pivots
children.geometryStrategy: Reuse the normalized plot Shape for three contiguous shallow bands; animate pivot offsets rather than editing vertices.

children.topology: low-segment closed cone with flat normals
children.geometryStrategy: THREE.ConeGeometry scaled to the footprint aspect ratio and inverted so its broad face meets the lowest soil band.

children.topology: one or more low-poly THREE.InstancedMesh batches
children.geometryStrategy: Deterministic points are rejection-sampled inside the normalized polygon bounding box. Geometry profile is selected by crop.model.

children.topology: THREE.Group containing low-poly pick meshes and named Object3D anchors
children.geometryStrategy: Small visible spheres provide forgiving raycast targets; non-rendered child anchors project to DOM glass labels.

cropGeometryProfiles.tomato: stem, low-poly foliage mass, and round fruit accent
cropGeometryProfiles.brinjal: stem, broad low-poly foliage mass, and elongated fruit accent
cropGeometryProfiles.chili: stem, narrow foliage mass, and tapered fruit accent

materials.localResponse: beveled rim catches the directional key

materials.albedo: crop.color shifted toward amber/red as plot score falls
materials.localResponse: subtle emissive lift while Crop Metrics is active
small emissive cue without bloom or postprocessing

lighting.hemisphere: warm cream sky and cool sage ground fill
lighting.directional: soft upper-left key with bounded desktop shadow map
lighting.contactShadow: layered translucent ellipses beneath the island; no postprocessing
lighting.background: transparent canvas over the CSS sage/cream gradient

pivots.action: hover yaw, hover pitch, idle yaw, and reduced-motion-safe bob

performanceBudget.rendering: requestAnimationFrame exists only while the dialog is open and the document is visible
